beginner.name: Getting Started
beginner.desc: Learn basic form and build a habit — get the technique right before adding volume.
beginner.focus: Sit-to-stand, wall push-up, glute bridge, dead bug, brisk walk 20–25'
beginner.nutrition: Apply the ½ veg – ¼ protein – ¼ carb plate for one meal per day
beginner.milestone: Complete 7/7 days; write 5 lines in a training journal each session

beginner.name: Building Base
beginner.desc: Keep week 1 structure but add slightly: +1 set or +5–10% reps.
beginner.focus: Squat to chair 3×10, knee push-up 3×10, cardio 30', technique micro-lesson
beginner.nutrition: Every main meal includes one protein source: eggs, fish, lean meat, beans
beginner.milestone: Plank 30 s unbroken; brisk walk 30' comfortably

beginner.name: Strengthening
beginner.desc: 5 exercises per strength session, cardio 30', introduce light dumbbells.
beginner.focus: Goblet squat, standard push-up, band row, light RDL, plank 40 s
beginner.nutrition: Smart carbs around workouts; 2 L water per day
beginner.milestone: Squat 3×12 with good form; brisk walk 35' comfortably

beginner.name: Progressing
beginner.desc: Increase volume and intensity steadily; start tracking measurements.
beginner.focus: Goblet squat 3×12, push-up 3×10, dumbbell row, RDL, split squat
beginner.nutrition: Add more fibre, limit sugary drinks, drink enough water
beginner.milestone: Push-up 3×10 proper form; plank 45 s; brisk walk 40' Zone 2

beginner.name: Developing
beginner.desc: Shorten rest periods and raise exercise difficulty with good form.
beginner.focus: Split squat, incline push-up, Romanian deadlift, light intervals
beginner.nutrition: Meal prep 2 meals/week to ensure adequate protein
beginner.milestone: Complete 4-week test: waist, sit-to-stand, plank, 12-min walk

beginner.name: Mastery
beginner.desc: Personalised routine based on your progress; sustainable long term.
beginner.focus: Choose exercises by goal; test every 4 weeks; adjust flexibly
beginner.nutrition: Maintain the healthy plate; no strict dieting needed
beginner.milestone: Complete 24 weeks — stronger body, sustainable habits

busy.name: Getting Started
busy.focus: 2' warm-up + 6' circuit (squat 30 s, push 30 s, plank 30 s) + 2' breathing
busy.nutrition: One meal per day with protein: eggs, yogurt, beans, fish
busy.milestone: 28/28 days without missing a session, even if only 10 min

busy.name: Keeping the Streak
busy.desc: Increase to 12–15 min when possible; hold at 10' on busy days.
busy.focus: Add one AMRAP round or add dead bug/bird-dog to the circuit
busy.nutrition: Eat slowly, don't skip breakfast, stay hydrated
busy.milestone: Body feels more flexible; less back fatigue after long days

busy.name: More Efficient
busy.desc: Add a lunchtime micro-session of 5–10' if possible; keep morning at 10'.
busy.focus: Morning: push/pull/squat/core 10'. Lunch: brisk walk 5–10' if available
busy.nutrition: Don't skip breakfast; protein within 30 min post-workout

busy.name: Progressing
busy.desc: Upgrade to 15 min/day when schedule allows; 3-round circuit.
busy.nutrition: Small meal prep: 2–3 protein meals ready each week
busy.milestone: Energy levels noticeably better throughout the day

busy.name: Developing
busy.desc: 20' on good days, 10' on busy days — a flexible system.
busy.focus: Flexible 10' vs 20' by schedule; add strength on weekends
busy.nutrition: Weekend meal prep to cover protein + vegetables all week

busy.name: Mastery
busy.desc: Sustainable habit — as automatic as brushing teeth.
busy.focus: Personal flexible system; self-adjusting day-to-day and week-to-week
busy.nutrition: Maintain protein + hydration; no extreme dieting
busy.milestone: 6 months consistent — healthy habits are now instinct

fatloss.name: Foundation
fatloss.desc: 3 strength + 2 Zone 2 cardio + 2 recovery sessions — don't overtrain.
fatloss.focus: Strength A/B/C full body + brisk walk/cycling 30–35' Zone 2
fatloss.nutrition: ½ plate veg, ¼ protein, ¼ carb — drink 2 L water per day
fatloss.milestone: Build a 5-session/week habit; record initial waist measurement

fatloss.name: Cardio Build
fatloss.desc: Cardio +5'/week; strength stays the same; increase daily NEAT.
fatloss.focus: Zone 2 cardio: 35–40'; add 2,000–3,000 extra steps per day
fatloss.nutrition: Protein ≥ 1 palm size per meal; limit sugary drinks

fatloss.name: Combining
fatloss.desc: Introduce light interval cardio; strength increases to 5 exercises/session.
fatloss.focus: 2' fast + 2' slow ×5 alternating cardio; strength 5 ex/session
fatloss.nutrition: Smart carbs: eat around workouts, reduce evening carbs
fatloss.milestone: Waist down 2–3 cm; lighter feeling climbing stairs

fatloss.name: Progressing
fatloss.desc: Steady volume increase; track weight + waist weekly.
fatloss.focus: Strength volume up; cardio 40–45'; NEAT target 8,000 steps
fatloss.nutrition: Track protein daily; basic macro balance
fatloss.milestone: Noticeable body composition change; daily steps up significantly

fatloss.name: Peak
fatloss.desc: Stronger strength + steady-state cardio; don't skip meals.
fatloss.focus: Circuit training + Zone 2 cardio; track morning weight
fatloss.nutrition: Meal prep, enough protein, no meal skipping, avoid late-night eating
fatloss.milestone: Reached initial weight goal; energy levels improved

fatloss.name: Maintenance
fatloss.desc: Slightly reduce volume; train sustainably; no extreme dieting.
fatloss.focus: Maintain 3 strength + 2 cardio; review goals and adjust
fatloss.nutrition: Naturally balanced eating; no strict restrictions
fatloss.milestone: 6 months sustained — healthy body, healthy eating habits

muscle.name: Foundation
muscle.desc: Learn lifting form: basic Push/Pull/Legs split, RPE 7 while keeping technique.
muscle.focus: Goblet squat, push-up/bench, band/dumbbell row, RDL, plank
muscle.nutrition: Protein 1.6–2 g/kg bodyweight; eat enough calories for recovery
muscle.milestone: Learn correct form for 5 foundational movements; no joint pain

muscle.name: Volume Build
muscle.desc: Increase sets and reps; perfect form is the top priority.
muscle.nutrition: Eat enough calories; protein within 30 min post-workout; carbs pre-workout
muscle.milestone: Squat 4×10 with good form; clearly feel muscles working

muscle.name: Combining
muscle.desc: Add compound movements, light load increases, clearer Upper/Lower split.
muscle.focus: Deadlift 4×6–8, pull-up/lat pulldown, dips/close-grip push, hip thrust
muscle.nutrition: Carbs pre-workout; protein post; sufficient healthy fats (fish, avocado, nuts)

muscle.name: Progressing
muscle.desc: Upper A/B + Lower A/B: 4 days/week; steady strength gains.
muscle.focus: Upper A (chest/back), Upper B (shoulder/arm), Lower A/B (quad/ham)
muscle.nutrition: Sufficient calories; attention to healthy fats; protein every 3–4 hours
muscle.milestone: Consistent compound lift gains each week

muscle.name: Developing
muscle.desc: Highest volume in the cycle; strength test every 4 weeks; check PRs.
muscle.focus: 5–6 exercises/session; 3–4 sets; rest 90–120 s compound, 60 s accessories
muscle.nutrition: Serious meal prep; protein every 3–4 hours; adequate carbs on training days

muscle.name: Advanced
muscle.desc: Specialise on weak points; deload week 24; plan the next cycle.
muscle.focus: Follow individual progress; 1 deload week every 4–6 weeks
muscle.nutrition: Balance micro-cycles: cut/bulk based on goal
muscle.milestone: 6 months — look back at visible body and strength transformation

endurance.name: Aerobic Base
endurance.desc: Pure Zone 2 cardio + minimal strength to maintain muscle.
endurance.focus: 30' walk/cycling Zone 2 (can still speak short sentences) + squat, push, row, glute
endurance.nutrition: Enough carbs for energy; drink 2–2.5 L water per day

endurance.name: Volume Build
endurance.desc: Cardio +5'/week; add light intervals once per week.
endurance.focus: 35–40' Zone 2 + 4 interval bouts 2' fast (Zone 3–4), alternate 2' easy
endurance.nutrition: Add electrolytes when sweating heavily; carbs before long sessions
endurance.milestone: 40' Zone 2 comfortable; heart rate recovers faster

endurance.name: Building
endurance.desc: Cardio 40–50'; add tempo run or moderate cycling intervals.
endurance.focus: Tempo run 20' (Zone 3) or cycling intervals; strength 2×/week to keep muscle
endurance.nutrition: Carbs around long sessions; protein for recovery post-workout
endurance.milestone: Steady 20' tempo run; cardio fitness clearly improved

endurance.name: Progressing
endurance.desc: Long ride/run on weekends 60–75'; maintain midweek intervals.
endurance.focus: Long Zone 2 Saturday (60–75'); intervals Wednesday; strength 2×
endurance.nutrition: Recovery nutrition: protein + carbs 30 min after long session
endurance.milestone: Complete 60' Zone 2 without breaks; stable heart rate

endurance.name: Peak
endurance.desc: Peak endurance; long ride/run 75–90'; conquer your target.
endurance.nutrition: Fuelling strategy for long sessions; replace electrolytes; adequate carbs
endurance.milestone: Event-ready: 10 km, cycling race, or open-water swim

endurance.name: Maintenance
endurance.desc: Sustain aerobic base without overtraining; balance cardio and muscle.
endurance.focus: Balance endurance and strength; recover properly; don't fear rest days
endurance.nutrition: Balanced diet; add iron if training hard; stay well hydrated
endurance.milestone: 6 months — strong aerobic base; more efficient body

advanced.name: Adaptation
advanced.desc: Cycling 40' + Gym + Swimming 50'/day — adapt to high training volume.
advanced.nutrition: ~3,000 kcal heavy days; ~2,800 moderate days; protein ~155 g/day
advanced.milestone: Complete the full 7-day schedule without excessive fatigue

advanced.name: Volume Build
advanced.desc: +5–10% gym volume per week; keep cycling and swimming stable.
advanced.focus: Increase reps on gym accessories; cycling stays Zone 2–3; swim 1,500–2,000 m
advanced.nutrition: Increase kcal on heavy training days; replace electrolytes after long rides
advanced.milestone: Complete weekly schedule with better energy than week 1

advanced.name: Developing
advanced.desc: Add Zone 3–4 cycling intervals; build swim to 1,500–2,000 m consistently.
advanced.focus: Cycling Zone 3 intervals; swim 1,500–2,000 m/session; gym RPE 7–8
advanced.nutrition: Macro tracking on heavy days; carbs around endurance sessions
advanced.milestone: Swim 1,500 m unbroken; cycling 5×3' Zone 4 intervals

advanced.name: Peak
advanced.desc: Peak training load: gym 5 days + cycling 5 days + swimming 5 days/week.
advanced.focus: Long ride 120' Saturday; full gym 5 days; swim to maintain technique
advanced.nutrition: Enough calories; 7–8 h sleep/night; stretching after every session
advanced.milestone: Complete 120' ride; gym PR on compound lifts

advanced.name: Deload + Maintenance
advanced.desc: Deload week 17: reduce volume 30%, keep intensity — genuine recovery.
advanced.focus: Reduce volume 30%; keep intensity; prioritise sleep and massage
advanced.nutrition: Prioritise 7–8 h sleep; supplement omega-3 and magnesium
advanced.milestone: Post-deload: feel fresh, motivated to train again

advanced.name: Mastery
advanced.desc: Sustainable cycle: adjust by HRV and body signals.
advanced.focus: Monitor HRV; adjust flexibly; never ignore signs of fatigue
advanced.nutrition: Long-term balance; no extremes; maintain protein intake
advanced.milestone: 6 months elite training — outstanding cardio and muscular health

Walk/cycling 30–35' Zone 2 — still able to talk
Hip hinge, split squat, dead bug, calf raise
Mobility 15' + target +2,000 extra steps in the day
Push-up, scapular squeeze, glute bridge, bird-dog

Squat, Romanian deadlift, leg press, calf, plank

Split squat, RDL, bird-dog, plank, calf raise
Light walk 20–30' or full rest if fatigued

Gym Pull 45' (Deadlift, row, face pull) + Swim 50'

ui.progress_note: Increase gradually each week; listen to your body
ui.if_achieve_early: If you hit the milestone before week {{week}}, increase intensity or add new exercises.
ui.progress_eval: Evaluate progress every 2 weeks: compare form, completion time, and how your endurance feels.
ui.water_note: Drink 2–2.5 litres of water daily; prioritise plain water and fresh vegetable juices.
ui.meal_timing_note: Eat 3 full meals; limit unhealthy snacks, especially after 8 pm.
ui.plate_note: ½ veg – ¼ protein – ¼ carb
ui.complete_note: Tick each day on the calendar
ui.reward_note: Treat yourself when you hit a milestone
